name: Roosevelt Field
summary: Roosevelt Field is a premier regional shopping destination on Long Island featuring over 270 specialty stores, diverse dining options, and a cinema. This expansive Simon Property Group mall serves as a comprehensive retail and entertainment hub for Nassau County and the broader New York metropolitan area.
demographics: Roosevelt Field attracts a diverse, affluent demographic from Nassau County and the broader Long Island area, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle-class families and young professionals. The trade area serves households with above-average incomes, drawn from surrounding communities like Garden City, Mineola, and Westbury. Shoppers tend to be fashion-conscious consumers seeking both premium and mainstream retail options, with a significant percentage of visitors in the 25-54 age range. The center benefits from Long Island's dense suburban population and serves as a regional destination for both everyday shopping and special occasion purchases.
description: Roosevelt Field stands as one of the premier shopping destinations on Long Island and ranks among the largest malls in the New York metropolitan area. With over 270 specialty stores spread across its expansive footprint, this iconic regional mall has been serving the Garden City community and surrounding areas for decades. The center offers an exceptional mix of retailers ranging from luxury brands to popular mainstream chains, complemented by a diverse food court and multiple sit-down dining options for shoppers seeking a complete experience. Entertainment amenities include a modern cinema complex, making Roosevelt Field not just a shopping center but a comprehensive lifestyle destination. Managed by Simon Property Group, one of the nation's leading retail real estate companies, the mall maintains high standards of service and continues to evolve with the changing retail landscape, consistently attracting millions of visitors annually with its convenient location on Old Country Road and reputation for quality shopping.
